rows.grounds: numeral element forming the count eighty-four thousand
locative plural expressing location within a large number
compound of yoni and yantra indicating devices or matrices of birth
past passive participle describing beings subjected to affliction

items.question: Within what vast multitude of womb-mechanisms are beings subjected to torment?
premises: The count specified is eighty-four thousand.
The locations named are womb-mechanisms or matrices of birth.
Beings within these locations are described as tormented.
items.inference: Beings suffer torment throughout the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
uncertainties: The specific subjects tormented are implied from the preceding context rather than named in this verse.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
